Thanks — quick read-through notes below.

1) Retention: 7 years is a non-starter. Standard is 90 days for request logs with options for extended retention via paid add-on or SOC2/audit bundles. Proposed counter: 13 months retention with audit export on request.

2) Indemnity: their removal of the third-party content carve materially increases risk. Legal will propose replacing the absolute carve with a scoped representation that limits Redwood liability for customer-supplied prompts and outputs, plus a mutual indemnity for IP claims.

3) SLA latency: median 50ms for 'priority endpoints' — need to define what qualifies as priority and where this metric is measured (app vs edge). We can propose a tiered SLA: p50 50ms for priority in the hosted US-west region under Dedicated capacity with penalties capped per-month (not unlimited).

4) Appendix for Dedicated lane: we will draft a deployment appendix that includes capacity reservation, monitoring hooks (trace IDs, token-level billing reports), canary plan and automatic fallback to best-effort pool. This will be an addendum to the Order Form (Appendix A).

I suggest we push back on 7 years retention and the indemnity language, accept the capacity appendix discussion but control the SLA penalty structure.

I will prepare redline suggestions and an internal summary for Rishi to send as our counter.

- Lauren
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Rishi / team — pricing note: the 25M tokens/mo uplift + burst to 35M in peak months maps to the following: list price delta = $XXk/mo (I put numbers in the attached OrderForm v3). We can fold dedicated lane as a 12% premium on reserved capacity for Q1-Q2 2027 to cover overhead.

If legal wants SLA penalties capped, we can accept a credits-based SLA (monthly credit up to 10% of monthly fees) rather than an uncapped indemnity exposure.

I attached the updated OrderForm with pricing scenarios for Rishi to include in our response.

Emily — thanks for the redlines and for the clear asks. Our internal team reviewed and we can summarize our counter as follows: 

- Retention: we cannot accept 7 years in the MSA. We can offer a 13-month retention baseline and a separate compliance add-on for extended archival (we've attached pricing options).
- Indemnity/IP: legal proposes scoped mutual indemnities and a representation that customer-provided prompts/inputs remain customer's responsibility. We will not accept an unconstrained carve that shifts third-party IP risk entirely to Redwood.
- SLA: propose to define 'priority endpoints' in Appendix A (attached) and provide a p50 target of 50ms for priority endpoints when served from Dedicated lane in US-west. SLA will be credits-based with a monthly cap equal to 10% of monthly fees.
- Dedicated lane appendix: we attach a draft Appendix A describing capacity reservation, canary plan, monitoring hooks, and fallback behavior. This will be appended to the Order Form.

Attached: StratusAI_Redwood_Counter_MSA_redline_20261123.docx, OrderForm_v3_RedwoodPriced.xlsx, AppendixA_DedicatedLane_draft.pdf

If this looks broadly acceptable, can your team indicate which items are deal-breakers so we can prioritize legal vs commercial? Happy to hop on a call tomorrow to walk through.

Best,
